author: More Perfect Union
description:
Republican Senator Tim Sheehy just attacked anti-war protestor Brian McGinnis during a subcommittee hearing.

Sheehy joined Capitol Police is lifting McGinnis up and physically ejecting him from the hearing.

McGinnis can be heard saying "No one wants to fight for Israel!!" And bystanders can he heard saying "They broke his hand! A sitting US Senator just broke the hand of a Marine."
title: U.S. Senator attacks anti-war Marine - breaking his hand

author: More Perfect Union
description:
Mobile home parks are one of the last sites of truly affordable housing in America.

But now corporations and landlords see them as another cash cow.

So residents are organizing. We went to Montana, where people are forming tenant unions and fighting for housing they can afford.

Producer: Trevor Hayes
Editor: @niklaak
Videographer: David Abate
Supervising Producer: Court Fuller
title: Corporate greed is ruining the last affordable housing in the US. These tenants are fighting back.
